data.name: Silver Allergy Stain
data.description: When you're not in your shifted form and you touch silver, including being struck by a silver weapon, you're sickened for 1 round. Immunities don't prevent this sickened condition, and you can't remove it early. You can try to hide this aversion with a Bluff check opposed by Sense Motive.
